title: Finite normalization of an already reduced diagonal diagram
statement: Let l be prime, Y,P=ProjectiveLine Y,W=diagonalSurface Y Noetherian, l invertible on Y, with DiagonalTraceLocalizations on all three schemes. Supply the completed reduction D, its completion and cycle-system specifications, a completed arrow delta normalized by IsDiagonalLimit, and a Family with a Reference to that arrow [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference]. Fix E, a maximal-ideal generator pi and n>=0. Assume the lifted residue ring A=ULift(O_E/(pi)^(n+1)) finite, killed by l^(n+1), this exponent invertible on Y,W, and normalized FiniteRoots on P,W. Let d be an already constructed quotient Diagram and supply ScalarCompatibility of family.integral E with d along the quotient map. Then there exist finite realizations eY,eP,eW and QuotientLineRealizations lineP,lineW at the fixed exponent r=n [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-quotient-line], for which FiniteDiagonalComparison [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-diagonal] holds. In particular the finite image of d.delta is the canonical positive Cartier arrow and d.traceq is the inverse positive unit/Chern splitting followed by constant projection. This theorem constructs neither d nor its scalar compatibility or integration identities.

proof.text: Construct the three exact finite realizations, the two positive-root endpoints, the normalized diagonal source isomorphism and the ordinary q direct-image comparison, independently of the completed class and trace.

Apply finiteTracePresentation_exists at exponent n+1 and the supplied finite quotient ring. This proved generic helper constructs the canonical finite right-derived q_* model with its full cochain-unit equation, derives the supplied ordinary square retaining its normalization, and selects the positive splitting with hom geoP1TwistedMap.

Use the completed-arrow reduction with the supplied source and lineW endpoint for the Cartier equation. Use completed-trace reduction with the constructed normalized square and canonical splitting for the trace equation. Apply the proved generic finiteDiagonalComparison_of_equations to assemble these witnesses and both equalities into FiniteDiagonalComparison without changing its statement.

theorem diagonalUniformizer_finiteNormalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (hcompletion : DiagonalCompletionSpec l (diagonalSurface Y) D)
    (hsystem : DiagonalCycleSystemSpec l Y hY D)
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (hδ : DiagonalTrace.IsDiagonalLimit l Y hY D δ)
    (family : Family l Y) (reference : Reference l Y δ family)
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l) (π : PadicAlgCl.integers l E)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers l E)) (n : ℕ)
    (hfinite : Finite (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)))
    (hA : ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) = 0)
    (hYpow : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (hWpow : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(diagonalSurface Y, ⊤)))
    (rootsP : FiniteRoots (ProjectiveLine Y) (l ^ (n + 1)))
    (rootsW : FiniteRoots (diagonalSurface Y) (l ^ (n + 1)))
    (d : Diagram (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      Y (quotientLine l E π n))
    (scalar : ScalarCompatibility (quotientMap l E π n) Y
      (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E) (quotientLine l E π n)
      (quotientLineMap l E π n) (family.integral E) d) :
    ∃ (eY : FiniteRealization
        (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
        (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) Y)
      (eP : FiniteRealization
        (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
        (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) (ProjectiveLine Y))
      (eW : FiniteRealization
        (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
        (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) (diagonalSurface Y))
      (lineP : QuotientLineRealization l E π n n hA (ProjectiveLine Y) eP)
      (lineW : QuotientLineRealization l E π n n hA (diagonalSurface Y) eW),
      FiniteDiagonalComparison
        (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
        (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) (hfinite := hfinite)
        (l ^ (n + 1)) (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) hA Y hYpow hWpow
        (quotientLine l E π n) d eY eP eW (lineP.iso l) (lineW.iso l)
